summary: Frontend UI-only testing of Slangcart Vendor Cloud-POS mobile parity (6 new screens + dashboard tile grid). Alice logged in via in-browser /api/auth/login. All 6 quick-link tiles (vendor-pos-link-{pos,sales,invoices,cash,analytics,settings}) render and navigate correctly. Settings: business_name typed + Save changes → value persists across reload (verified GET returns 'Alice Shop 1782907506'). POS: product chip tap adds line (qty=1, GST=18, ₹118); qty→2 recalculates to ₹236 client-side; 'Prices include GST' toggle re-derives to ₹200; customer name/phone captured; 'Take payment' opens modal with cash preselected at grand total; 'Add split' appends 2nd payment row; 'Save & print' → sale INV-0001 created on backend (verified via API — grand_total=200, gst_inclusive=true, customer.name='Test Buyer'). Sales history: list shows INV-0001, filter chips (All/completed/cancelled/refunded) render, status badge=COMPLETED. Invoices: sale card shows; tapping card opens preview modal with business_name/BILL TO/items table/totals/payments block correctly populated. Cash: today's expected close ₹200, breakdown by mode (cash ₹200, UPI ₹0), today's statement running balance ₹200. Analytics: KPI cards for TODAY+MONTH, day filter chips (7/15/30/60/90) — 7d switch to 'LAST 7 DAYS' verified; daily-turnover chart + all 4 rank lists (top_sold/top_revenue/top_gst/least_sold) render. NOTE: Interaction workaround required — TouchableOpacity onPress does not fire from Playwright's normal locator.click() on RN-Web; had to use MouseEvent dispatch (mousedown+mouseup+click) as noted by main agent. CRITICAL BUG on web preview: Alert.alert() with multi-button prompts (Cancel-sale, Refund-sale confirmations in sales.tsx, and 'Sale saved' success prompt in pos.tsx) does NOT render any confirm UI on react-native-web — no native window.confirm, no in-DOM modal, no dialog event. Sale-cancel and sale-refund flows are therefore unusable via the web preview. Test verified the underlying API works (backend sale still status='completed' because confirm never fires). This affects web preview only; native mobile Alert.alert should work.

ui_bugs.issue: Alert.alert(title, msg, [buttons]) does not render any confirm UI on react-native-web (web preview). Cancel-sale and Refund-sale destructive confirmations never appear, so users cannot cancel/refund via the web preview. Also the 'Sale saved · Invoice X' success prompt is not shown, so after Save & print the user gets no feedback that the sale succeeded and no path to open the invoice. Recommend replacing multi-button Alert.alert calls with a custom in-DOM modal (or using a cross-platform confirm shim).

None of the TextInputs on the new POS screens have testID. Selecting by placeholder is fragile because several fields have no placeholder (e.g. Field component uses <Text> label + <TextInput> with no placeholder). Recommend adding testIDs like 'pos-settings-business-name', 'pos-cart-qty-{i}', 'pos-customer-name' etc. for reliable E2E.

integration_issues.issue: Tap on 'Cancel' link fires Alert.alert but confirm modal never appears on web; sale.status stays 'completed'. Verified backend endpoint POST /api/vendor/me/pos/sales/{id}/cancel works (tested in iter28 pytest). UI wiring alone is broken on web.

issues: Cart row on 390px width: qty/price/disc/GST% inputs (small w=40/66/56/50) plus the remove-X icon are cramped and wrap; qty-input touch target is 30×40 (<44 min).
Cart line-total is rendered as small (13px) primary-color text below the qty row — easy to miss.
Tiles use width:'31%' with gap:8, which fits 3 per row on 390px but total width ≈ 3×31%+16=109% — verified rendering is fine but slight horizontal-jitter risk on narrower devices.

react_native_issues.issue: Runtime warning: '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web'. Not related to this iteration but noticeable in every session. Reference: (global).

Warnings: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' — appear on every screen. Cosmetic. Reference: (global styles in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts + several components).

action_items: HIGH: Replace Alert.alert(...) multi-button prompts in sales.tsx (doCancel/doRefund) and the 'Sale saved' block in pos.tsx (submit success) with a custom in-DOM Modal so the confirm/success flow works on web. Same replacement is likely needed anywhere else Alert.alert with buttons is used in the vendor/* screens.

MEDIUM: Add testID props to all POS TextInputs, product chips, cart rows, payment mode pills, and save buttons. Suggested: pos-settings-business-name, pos-search, pos-product-chip-{id}, pos-cart-qty-{i}, pos-customer-name, pos-take-payment, pos-save-print, sales-row-{id}, sales-cancel-{id}, sales-refund-{id}, invoices-card-{id}, analytics-day-{n}.
MEDIUM: Improve cart-row layout for narrow phones — stack qty controls / GST% below name on <400px, or use bigger touch targets (≥44px).

LOW: Alice's DB seed did not have is_vendor=true / vendor_status=approved even though approval_status='approved' — main agent's assumption was incorrect. I patched via mongo directly and inserted 1 test product for POS. Main agent should ensure the app has a documented path for Alice → vendor role or update the seed script.
LOW: Consider adding an in-page toast after Save & print (in place of the currently-swallowed Alert) so users get feedback the invoice was saved.
critical_code_review_comments: sales.tsx: doCancel/doRefund rely exclusively on RN Alert.alert with buttons which is a no-op on react-native-web — destructive actions therefore cannot be confirmed on the web preview build.
pos.tsx: submit success uses Alert.alert with 'View'/'New sale' buttons — same web limitation, silently loses success feedback and navigation opportunity.
settings.tsx / pos.tsx Field component doesn't propagate testID; consider forwarding a testID prop for E2E.

vendor-pos-client.ts: computeBillTotals mutates the input items array in place (assigns discount_amount/taxable/tax_amount/line_total on each item). POS screen invokes this inside a useMemo with [...cart] (shallow copy) but the inner objects are still the same refs — subsequent re-renders will keep whatever the memo wrote. Works today but is a subtle side-effect worth cleaning up.
dashboard.tsx L61: the 'if error message contains "vendor" → redirect to apply' heuristic is brittle — any 500 with a vendor-related message would boot the user out.

success_rate.backend: n/a (frontend-only request; backend endpoints verified live via curl during setup)
success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all 6 screens render + POS create-sale flow end-to-end works; only Cancel/Refund/Success-alert flows fail on web due to Alert.alert limitation)

Use MouseEvent dispatch (mousedown/mouseup/click) for RN-Web TouchableOpacity because locator.click() alone doesn't fire onPress. When retesting cancel/refund/save-success flows after main agent replaces Alert.alert with a modal, tap the destructive link, then look for and tap the new in-DOM 'Yes, cancel' button.
rca_of_issue: react-native-web's Alert.alert with buttons is either a stub or falls back to window.alert() stripping the button array — either way no confirm UI/button-onPress handlers fire on web preview. Empirically: after tapping the row 'Cancel' link on sales.tsx, no dialog event was captured by Playwright's page.on('dialog'), no [role=dialog]/[aria-modal] appeared in DOM, and the sale status on the backend remained 'completed' (verified via GET /api/vendor/me/pos/sales — status:'completed'). Also the 'Sale saved · Invoice INV-0001' success prompt in pos.tsx never surfaced after Save & print despite the underlying POST /vendor/me/pos/sales returning 200 with a valid invoice_no. Fix: replace multi-button Alert.alert calls in sales.tsx (doCancel/doRefund) and pos.tsx (submit success) with a custom in-DOM Modal (or import an existing ConfirmModal from /app/frontend/src). Note: my automation may have picked up the filter chip 'cancelled' via a substring match on the first 'text=Cancel' selector — main agent should manually retest the row-level Cancel/Refund taps as a sanity check before/after the Alert→Modal migration.
